Specification of Log and Trace
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
1 Introduction and functional overview
This specification specifies the functionality of the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
Log and Trace
.
The
Log and Trace
provides interfaces for
Adaptive Application
s to forward
logging information onto the communication bus, the console, to the file system or to
ARTI-trace. Each of the provided logging information has its own severity level. For
each severity level, a separate method is provided to be used by applications or
Adap-
tive Platform Service
s, e.g. ara::com. In addition, utility methods are provided
to convert decimal values into the hexadecimal numeral system, or into the binary nu-
meral system.
To pack the provided logging information into a standardized delivery and presentation
format, a protocol is needed. For this purpose, the
LT protocol
can be used, which
is standardized within the AUTOSAR consortium.
The
LT protocol
can add additional information to the provided logging informa-
tion. This information can be used by a
Logging client
to relate, sort or filter the
received logging frames.
Detailed information regarding the use cases and the
LT protocol
itself are provided
by the PRS Log and Trace protocol specification. For more information regarding the
LT protocol
refer to [1].
